description: This file contains internal testing utilities and mock classes for distributed state dictionary verification in PyTorch, including mixins for tensor comparison, OSD verification, and classes for embedding modules with hooks and modifiers.

classes.name: VerifyStateDictMixin
classes.description: A mixin class providing methods to verify and compare distributed state dictionaries and model parameters.

classes.name: FusionEmbedding
classes.description: A neural network module with two embedding layers for fusion purposes.

classes.name: FusionEmbeddingWithHook
classes.description: An extension of FusionEmbedding that registers hooks to modify state_dict keys during save/load.

classes.name: FusionEmbeddingWithModifier
classes.description: A subclass of FusionEmbeddingWithHook that provides a method to modify fully qualified name mappings.

methods.name: _compare_tensor
methods.description: Compares two tensors for equality, optionally offloading to CPU.

methods.name: _verify_msd
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of a model state dictionary against a distributed version.

methods.name: _verify_osd
methods.description: Verifies the optimizer state dictionary against a distributed version.

methods.name: _verify_osd_by_load
methods.description: Loads a distributed optimizer state dict into a model and optimizer, then verifies.

methods.name: _state_dict_hook
methods.description: Hook to modify the state_dict by removing 'embedding' from keys.

methods.name: _load_state_dict_hook
methods.description: Hook to modify the loaded state_dict by adding 'embedding' prefix to keys.

methods.name: _fqn_modifiers
methods.description: Provides a mapping for fully qualified name modifications for state_dict keys.
